title: EditObservation
description: One applied edit and later file observation.

observation_id.description: Stable id for this edit observation.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

user_id.description: The developer identity when known. Null when capture omitted it.

agent_harness.description: Which coding agent harness produced this fact.

file_path.description: Repo-relative path of the file the record concerns.

call_id.description: The tool-use id of the edit this pair describes.

applied_text.description: The replacement text that the edit tool applied.

observed_file_text.description: The complete file text observed at session end. Empty string means the file was deleted.

external_lines_added.description: Lines added by something other than the agent's edit tools between this edit and the next observation of the file. **External, not human** — a formatter, a linter, a watcher, or the agent's own shell all land here. Null means no window covered the call, which is not the same claim as 0.

external_lines_removed.description: Lines removed by something other than the agent's edit tools over the same window. Same caveats as `external_lines_added`.

occurred_at.description: When the edit was observed, stamped client-side.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.

raw.description: The source payload after Basic redaction, kept so a translator defect stays recoverable. Shape varies by provider; never join on it.
